questions.about: China: Zhou, Shang, Northern Wei, Western Wei
questions.question: Should the Zhou tag (Zhou dynasty, Eastern Zhou, Zhou states), Shang dynasty, and the Northern Wei and Western Wei tags go into China? Recommend: fold Zhou and Shang into China, keep the two Wei tags separate (low).

Should Cao Wei, Shu Han, Eastern Wu, the Ten Kingdoms, Southern Ming, Later Western Liang, and Xia be added to China even though they are drawn at the same time as other Chinese states? Recommend: add Cao Wei alone, leave the rest out.

Should Ayyubid Sultanate go into the Egypt tag (as Mamluk Sultanate is proposed) or stay in the separate Ayyubids tag with the Hama branch? Recommend: keep it as Ayyubids (low) and add the medieval Cairo dynasties to Egypt only at low.

Should Egypt take the Ptolemaic Kingdom, the medieval dynasties (Tulunids, Fatimids, Ikhshidids, Mamluks) and the rival pharaonic dynasties (the Fourteenth, Fifteenth, Sixteenth, and Twenty-third Dynasties, and Upper and Lower Egypt)? Recommend: add Ptolemaic (medium), the Seventeenth Dynasty (high), and the Cairo dynasties (low); leave the rival pharaonic dynasties out.

Should the Iran tag, which starts at the Safavids, take the Achaemenid, Parthian, and Sasanian empires, and at low the Medes, the Ilkhanate, and the Timurids? Recommend: add the three empires at medium; leave the Medes, Ilkhanate, and Timurids at low.

questions.about: India: British India, Delhi Sultanate, Maratha
questions.question: Should British India (its own tag) and the Delhi Sultanate tag merge into India, which already holds the Mughal Empire? Recommend: merge British India into India; leave the Delhi Sultanate separate until you decide on a wider India.

Should the 50 or so colony chains (Kenya, Tanzania, Guyana, Cameroon, Indonesia, and others) be applied as a batch, and how should the weak ones be treated (Nigeria, South Africa, Mali, Samoa, Somaliland)? Recommend: apply the high and medium ones as a batch; look at the low ones one by one.

questions.about: South Africa and the Boer republics
questions.question: Should Transvaal, Orange Free State, and Natal be folded into South Africa, since all four colonies made the Union of 1910? Recommend: leave them separate, and keep South Africa at low.

Which union names go with which partner: Czechoslovakia with Czechia (Slovakia has its own tag), the Kingdom of the Two Sicilies with Sicily (and not Italy), Norway-Denmark with Norway, and Jülich-Berg with Berg? Recommend: apply Norway-Denmark and Jülich-Berg; keep Czechoslovakia in Czechia (Slovakia has its own tag), and keep the Two Sicilies in Sicily.
Should the Holy Roman Empire tag (East Francia, Kingdom of Germany, Holy Roman Empire) merge with Germany, which follows the Prussian line? Recommend: keep them separate (medium).

Should the partition lines removed from Bavaria (Upper, Lower, Ingolstadt, Landshut, Munich), Baden (Baden-Baden, Baden-Durlach), Nassau, Hanover (Lüneburg), Liechtenstein (Schellenberg), Powys and Munster be added back? Recommend: leave them out; Powys and Munster lost their tag entirely.
Should the name Prussia (1233 to 1282) be removed from the Germany tag, and the Teutonic Order added to it? Recommend: remove Prussia from Germany; add the Teutonic Order at low.

How should horde and khaganate splits be tagged: Great Horde under Golden Horde, Eastern and Western Göktürks apart, Western Karakhanid out, Oirat with Dzungars, and Kazakh Khanate with Kazakhstan? Recommend: accept the high and medium splits; leave Golden Horde, Kazakhstan, and Oirat at low; keep Blue and White Horde out.

Should the Three Kingdoms (Silla, Baekje, and Goguryeo) and South and North Korea join the Korea tag, which starts at Goryeo and Joseon? Recommend: keep the Three Kingdoms as separate tags; add both Koreas or neither, and I lean to neither.
Should East Germany join Germany as West Germany already has, and the four occupation zones go to the two German states? Recommend: add East Germany at low; leave the zones out.

Should Vietnam include Âu Lạc and the Trưng sisters, and should Annam, the Trịnh and Nguyễn lords and South Vietnam be added; should Cambodia take Funan and Laos take Champasak and Vientiane? Recommend: keep the tag at medium as proposed and add none of the regional lords.

Should Kakheti stay a separate low tag, and should Georgia and Armenia keep the bare modern names Georgia (567 to 2026) and Armenia (710 to 2026) that overlap every medieval name? Recommend: keep both, with the overlap noted; keep Kakheti at low.

Should Wallachia and Moldavia join Romania, and should Transylvania and the Eastern Hungarian Kingdom join Hungary, which has no name for 1526 to 1918? Recommend: keep Wallachia and Moldavia as their own tags; leave Hungary as proposed.

Should Kievan Rus' and Principality of Kiev go with Russia, Ukraine, or neither, and should Novgorod and the Cossack Hetmanate be linked? Recommend: keep Kievan Rus' as its own tag (medium) and do not link it to a modern country.

Should the new tags for kingdoms that were later absorbed (Aragon, León, Navarre, Al-Andalus; Scotland, Wales, Ireland, Isle of Man; Sicily, Venice, Genoa) fold into Spain, Britain, and Italy? Recommend: keep them separate; the tags can be linked later.

Should the culture tags (Maya, Zapotec, Aztec, Inca, Toltec, Chimú, Purépecha, Haudenosaunee) and the people-variant tags (Ainu, Tungus, Jōmon, Berbers, Tuareg, Xiongnu) be kept? Recommend: keep the state-like ones (Inca, Aztec, Chimú, Haudenosaunee) and drop Maya and Tungus.
Should Upper Canada, the Atlantic colonies, and British Columbia join Canada, and the six Australian colonies join Australia? Recommend: leave out, and revisit if you want federation tags.

Should the Caliphate tag (Rashidun to Abbasid) exist, should Aksum merge into Ethiopia, and should Muscat and the Nabhani and Yarubid dynasties go into Oman? Recommend: drop the Caliphate tag, keep Aksum separate, and leave the Omani dynasties alone.

Should the Western Roman Empire and the Nicaean Empire go into Rome even though both are drawn beside Rome's eastern half, and should Roman provinces be tagged at all? Recommend: add Western Roman Empire at medium; leave Nicaea and the provinces out.
South Korea and North Korea are drawn at the same time (81 years) and each claims to continue Korea. Add both, or neither?

The Fourteenth Dynasty ruled the Delta at the same time as the Middle Kingdom (149 years on the map). Add it to Egypt anyway?
The Twenty-third Dynasty is drawn at the same time as the Twenty-second (99 years) and was a rival line. Add it to Egypt anyway?
Upper Egypt and Lower Egypt are two halves drawn at the same time (2200 BC to 2001 BC). Add both to Egypt, or neither?
Should Ayyubid Sultanate go into Egypt (it ruled from Cairo) or stay in the separate Ayyubids tag with the Hama branch?

Sukhothai Kingdom (1241 to 1458) is drawn at the same time as Ayutthaya Kingdom for 106 years. It is the conventional first Thai kingdom; add it to Thailand anyway?

questions.about: Nassau: Principality of Nassau-Usingen, Principality of Nassau-Weilburg
questions.question: I left Principality of Nassau-Usingen and Principality of Nassau-Weilburg out of the proposed Nassau tag because they are two partition lines drawn together for 159 years. Add them back?

I left Lordship of Schellenberg out of the proposed Liechtenstein tag because it was a separate lordship drawn at the same time as the County of Vaduz (70 years) until they were joined in 1719. Add it back?
I did not propose a "New Jersey" tag (Province of New Jersey) because only one name is left after the rival or concurrent names were removed. Is that right?
I did not propose a "Moesia" tag (Moesia; Moesia Inferior) because its only link is a shared place name, and it is a Roman province, not a country. Is that right?

I did not propose a "Hindu kingdoms" tag (Hindu kingdoms; Hindu Kingdoms) because "Hindu kingdoms" is a placeholder for many states, not one country, and the second name is a spelling duplicate. Is that right?

I did not propose a "Proto-Altaic pastoralists" tag (Proto-Altaic pastoralists; Prot-Altaic Proto-Altaic pastoralists) because both names are undated and one is a typo of the other; it is a culture, not a country. Is that right?
I did not propose a "Papuans" tag (Papou; Papous) because both names are undated spelling variants of a people, not a country. Is that right?
I did not propose a "Powys" tag (Kingdom of Powys) because only one name is left after the rival or concurrent names were removed. Is that right?
I did not propose a "Munster" tag (Kingdom of Munster) because only one name is left after the rival or concurrent names were removed. Is that right?

I did not propose a "Corsica" tag (Corsican Republic; Anglo-Corsican Kingdom) because its only link is a shared island name; the Corsican Republic and the Anglo-Corsican Kingdom are different states. Is that right?

Kingdom of Kartli-Kakheti stays in Georgia, so the Kakheti tag (Kakheti-Hereti, Kingdom of Kakheti) is a separate low tag; Kingdom of Kakheti is drawn at the same time as Kingdom of Kartli. Keep Kakheti separate?

Bengal Sultanate (Sultanate of Bengal, Hussain Shahi dynasty) and Bengal Subah (Bengal Subah, Bengal, Nawabs of Bengal) are two tags because the Mughals conquered the sultanate; one regional agent proposed a single Bengal tag. Kashmir and Jammu and Kashmir are likewise split; Jammu (1700 to 1807) is left out. Merge any of them?
Where several files proposed the same country under different labels I used the plain modern name (Ivory Coast, Chola, Maratha Empire, Adal, Zhou). Prefer Côte d'Ivoire, Cholas, or Ifat for any?
Viceroyalty of New Spain is in the Mexico tag but matches nothing on the map; is it drawn under another title, or should the entry go?
Should Gran Colombia (1820 to 1830) go with Colombia, with Venezuela, with Ecuador, or with none of them, and should Cundinamarca (1814) join Colombia?

Should New Netherland go with the Province of New York, Saybrook Colony and New Haven Colony with Connecticut Colony, and Spanish Florida with East Florida, even though each change was a conquest or merger?
Should the Canadian colonies (New Brunswick, Nova Scotia, British Columbia, Newfoundland, New France, Rupert's Land, and others) join Canada, or the six Australian colonies join Australia?
New Netherland is drawn 1614 to 1802 and centred in the middle of the Atlantic; are its dates and centre wrong?

questions.about: Balkans, Anatolia and the Caucasus (regional report)
questions.question: Mesopotamia (198 to 1921) runs from the Roman province to Mandatory Iraq; should it join the Iraq tag, or is it a regional name?

questions.about: Balkans, Anatolia and the Caucasus (regional report)
questions.question: Kingdom of Prilep, Tsardom of Vidin, and Kingdom of Imereti are successor fragments with no parent tag; should they join Serbia, Bulgaria, and Georgia?

questions.about: Central Asia and the steppe (regional report)
questions.question: Xia (2070 BC to 438) merges the legendary dynasty with Helian Xia, and Jin (750 BC to 262) merges the Jin state with the later dynasty; should each be split?

questions.about: Central Asia and the steppe (regional report)
questions.question: Should Northern Yuan and the Mongol Empire go with Yuan dynasty in China, or stay with the Mongols and Mongolia?

questions.about: Central Asia and the steppe (regional report)
questions.question: Blue Horde and White Horde overlap the Golden Horde; are they variants of it, or separate states?

questions.about: Central Asia and the steppe (regional report)
questions.question: Should Qocho Kingdom, Ganzhou Kingdom, and the Uyghur Khaganate share a tag as one Uyghur line?
Should Liao dynasty, Great Jin, Kingdom of Dali, and Northern Yuan be tagged China as conquest dynasties, or stay separate?
Should Kingdom of Dali join the Nanzhao tag as its successor, and Hokuzan and Nanzan join the Ryukyu tag even though they overlap Chüzan?
Should the Sixteen Kingdoms, the Samhan confederacies (Gaya, Byeonhan, Jinhan, and Mahan), and Northern Fujiwara get tags of their own?
Should Cossack Hetmanate, Zaporozhian Cossacks, and Sloboda Ukraine be one Ukraine tag with Ukraine, given the first two overlap for 120 years?
Is the Small Horde (1557 to 1774, titled Nogai Horde but centred on the Kazakh steppe) really the Kazakh Lesser Horde, and does the Rus' Khaganate belong with Kievan Rus'?
Do Principality of Peremyshl and Principality of Terebovlia belong with Principality of Halych, which formed from them in 1141?
Should Muscat (950 to 1520) and the Nabhani and Yarubid dynasties join the Oman tag, and Hotaki dynasty go to Iran, Afghanistan, or neither?
Mauritius and Réunion are in the Middle East file but centred in the Indian Ocean; are they misfiled?

Should the wartime occupation administrations (Reichskommissariats, General Government, Vichy-style regimes) and the Chinese puppet governments (Manchukuo, Mengjiang, and others) be tagged with the states they were carved from?
Should Second Philippine Republic join Philippines, Rwanda-Urundi join Rwanda or Burundi, Spanish Morocco join Morocco, and Pakistan and Bangladesh link to British India?
Should Malaysia, the Federated and Unfederated Malay States, Malaya, and the Straits Settlements share a tag?
Should Mahdist State (1885 to 1899) and Egyptian Sudan go with Sudan, and Emirate of Abdelkader with Algeria?
Sicily (843 to 902) in the western Europe file and the Emirate of Sicily (828 to 1090) look like one Muslim-ruled island; should they share a tag?
Should the Roman provinces (Aegyptus, Africa Proconsularis, Numidia, and others) go under Rome, and should Aghlabid, Zirid, Hammadid, and Banu Khazrun dynasties share a Maghreb tag?
Should Portuguese Colonies (1564 to 1885) and East Timor, drawn over the same years, be tagged together or with Portugal, and should East Timor start later?
Should Sur Empire (1540 to 1556) go into India, Vengi into Chalukya, and the Bahmani successors (Ahmadnagar, Berar, Bidar, Bijapur, and Golconda) into one Deccan tag?
Should Danish India, French India, and Portuguese India follow the Denmark, France, and Portugal tags?
Klachuris looks like a misspelling of Kalachuris and Shaskanka of Shashanka; should the names be corrected?
Should French Indochina go with Vietnam, stay tagless, or be split among Vietnam, Cambodia, and Laos?
Should Sunda Kingdom, Galuh Kingdom, and Tarumanagara be one tag, and should Srivijaya and Dharmasraya be linked?
Should Madagascar and Merina Kingdom share a tag, and should the Congo tag (which holds the Democratic Republic line) leave out Congo (1960 to 2026), which looks like the Republic of the Congo?
Should British Senegal and French West Africa join Senegal, and should Rwanda-Urundi join Rwanda or Burundi?
Should the Franks (Kingdom of the Franks, Carolingian Empire, Austrasia, Neustria) be one tag, or split between France and the Holy Roman Empire?
Should Lancastrian France go with Britain, France, or neither, and should the Spanish Empire go with Spain?
Should County of Barcelona, Catalonia (1640 to 1813), and the Irish kingdoms (Ulaid, Connacht, Northern Uí Néill) join the Aragon and Ireland tags?
Should Duchy of Greater Poland, Duchy of Kraków, and Duchy of Silesia (1139 to 1319) be added to Poland even though they overlap Kingdom of Poland?
The map has only Germany from 1918, with no Weimar Republic or Nazi Germany, and no Carniola; should those names be added?
Prussia (1233 to 1282) in the Germany tag is the land of the Old Prussians, not the Hohenzollern state; it was flagged by two regional reports (see the earlier question on the Teutonic Order).
